corrections.why: The list spells it 'wrigthsville', most likely a typo for the county seat, which Wikipedia spells Wrightsville. No source gives the tower a different name.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list spells the name 'wrigthsville' and Wikipedia spells the county seat 'Wrightsville'. Treated as a typo in the list.

notes_for_editor: Only one list line (GA243) supports this record. No build, design, staffing, height, current-status or site-condition source was found. The 'wrigthsville' spelling is treated as a typo; the name correction is for a human to accept or reject. The coordinates put the tower about 2.5 km south of Wikipedia's point for the city, which may not be the exact centre. Tags BLL-41091 and gfc-624 are printed as on the list and not expanded there. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists (both cached and checked). A web search turned up nothing about this tower. The johnsonco.org county history page returned HTTP 403 and was not read.
